contentList.content: Arcane Barrage
Fire a barrage of three arcane bolts.
Arcane Spheres

Restore an allies <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">Hit Points</LSTag>, or siphon the life of a nearby enemy, storing it in up to three arcane spheres. For each arcane sphere you hold, you will roll an additional die when targeting a creature with this action.
Arcane Spheres: 1
Affected creature has absorbed the life of a nearby enemy, boosting their damage and healing capabilities.
Arcane Spheres: 2
Affected creature has absorbed the life of two nearby enemies, greatly boosting their damage and healing capabilities.
Arcane Spheres: 3
Affected creature has absorbed the life of three nearby enemies, massively boosting their damage and healing capabilities.
